g.text: Each row has its own frozen observed range. Colors compare n within a case; they do not measure equal task difficulty.
Hatched cells have fewer than 3 eligible results. A mean of 100 with 1/3 eligible is not a 100% success rate.
RTE X15 includes partially feasible panels; full 15-case feasibility is reported separately. NS = n not scheduled.
